title: CHAPTER 10: CURRENT AFFAIRS AND RECENT DEVELOPMENTS

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Dholavira in Kutch was inscribed as India's 40th UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2021, recognized for its Harappan urban planning.
Gujarat International Finance Tec-City (GIFT City) in Gandhinagar serves as India's premier operational International Financial Services Centre (IFSC).
Space Applications Centre (SAC) in Ahmedabad plays a critical role in developing key payloads for ISRO's landmark space missions.
The Gujarat State Disaster Management Authority (GSDMA) was pioneered after the 2001 Bhuj earthquake as a benchmark model for disaster management in India.

blocks.content: Gujarat's rich cultural heritage and modern technological strides showcase a unique synergy between ancient preservation and futuristic infrastructure.

items: Dholavira is renowned for its unique three-tier city planning (Citadel, Middle Town, Lower Town) and advanced water management systems.
Historic City of Ahmedabad became India's first UNESCO World Heritage City in 2017.
Rani ki Vav in Patan, built by Queen Udayamati of the Solanki Dynasty, is featured on the Indian ₹100 note.
